description: Posts a comment on a post, or a reply to a comment, from a connected LinkedIn or Instagram account. SIDE EFFECT: posts a real public comment that this tool cannot take back. connectedAccountId is a connected workspace account with provider linkedin or instagram and status ok, owned by the caller or shared; postId is the id of a post as listed in a posts result; replyToCommentId is the id of a comment on the same post as listed in a comments result. commentAs comments as a LinkedIn company page the account administers. Returns id (the new comment, as listed in a comments result) and repeated. An idempotencyKey makes a retry safe: the same request with the same key returns the first result. A failed comment with an unknown outcome may already have gone out.

commentAs.description: LinkedIn only: the id of a company page the account administers, to comment as that page rather than as the person

connectedAccountId.description: The id of a connected workspace account with provider LinkedIn or Instagram and status 'ok'

idempotencyKey.description: Optional UUID. Repeating the identical request with the same key returns the first result with repeated true rather than commenting again; a different payload with a used key is refused

postId.description: The id of the post to comment on, as listed in a posts result

replyToCommentId.description: Optional id of a comment on the same post, as listed in a comments result, to reply to that comment rather than commenting on the post

text.description: The comment text, posted exactly as given (at most 1250 characters)

workspace.description: Slug or id of the workspace to work in. Optional when the account has exactly one usable workspace; required when it has several. An API key always works in its own workspace.

name: comment_on_social_post
title: Comment on social post
